Full-Arch Restorations Built Around Verified Implant Data

Definitive restorations supported by photogrammetry, grammetry, and digitally verified implant data—designed to improve fit, function, esthetics, and long-term restorative success.

Successful full-arch rehabilitation depends on more than manufacturing. Accurate implant verification, restorative planning, and precision fabrication all contribute to predictable outcomes.

Whether transitioning from a provisional restoration or starting with verified implant records, 3DDX provides restorative solutions built around clinical accuracy and efficient delivery.

Restorative Workflow Pathways

Direct-to-Final Restorations

Direct-to-Final Restorations
 

For clinicians who already have verified implant records and require final prosthetic delivery only.

Supported Records

  • Photogrammetry
  • Grammetry
  • Intraoral scans
  • Conventional physical records

Designed to Deliver

  • Passive-fit functional prosthesis
  • High-quality fabrication
  • Minimal/no adjustments

Integrated GFMR / GFMP Restorations

For clinicians seeking a complete restorative journey from surgery, temporary restorations through final delivery.

Includes

  • Guided implant placement
  • Immediate provisionalization
  • Implant data verification
  • Transition from provisionals to finals

Designed to Deliver

  • Workflow continuity
  • Restorative predictability
  • Coordinated treatment execution
Restoration Types & Manufacturing

Designed Around Clinical Requirements

Restoration selection is based on implant distribution, restorative space, esthetic goals, and long-term maintenance requirements.

Monolithic Zirconia

Designed for strength, esthetics, and simplified maintenance.

Bar-Supported Prosthetics

Ideal for advanced full-arch restorations requiring additional reinforcement.

Thimble-bar Prosthesis

Precision-milled frameworks engineered for long-term stability and passive fit.

Workflow

Digital ZirconiaTM Workflow

Use 3DDX digital design services to achieve a reliable final prosthetic outcome. Choose the option that best fits your practice and available restorative data.

Validate Before Final Fabrication

For clinicians with in-office 3D-printing capabilities, 3DDX offers a digital validation pathway before zirconia production begins.

Final try-in STL designs can be printed chairside and clinically verified before manufacturing.

Validate

  • Esthetics
  • Occlusion
  • Vertical clearance

Once approved, the restoration proceeds to final manufacturing through the 3DDX master ceramists.

Benefits

  • Faster delivery
  • Reduced remake risk
  • Greater restorative confidence
  • Smoother transition from provisional to final

Zirconia Copy Milling

Clinicians with approved restorative designs can submit files directly for CAD CAM milling dental restorations.

Services Include

  • Zirconia milling
  • Ceramic layering
  • Characterization
  • Quality-control verification
